guitar.notes: Stevie Ray Vaughan's battered Fender Stratocaster "Number One" is one of the most famous guitars in blues history; this should never have been left unknown since the artist IS the guitarist.

tone.target: warm singing clean lead with slow blues sustain
tone.profile: warm singing clean lead with slow blues sustain
tone.summary: A classic blues setup using a light boost for warmth, followed by a Fender-style clean amp model (US Deluxe) paired with a 2x12 cab, finished with gentle reverb and EQ shaping.
